feature: Restore complete numbered grammar explanations and color explicit translation verdict variants
rootCauses: Bold grammar headings such as 1．第46题 carried both a chapter ordinal and a question number; the parser did not recognize them as question boundaries and left most explanation blocks in global content.
The verdict decorator recognized only a narrow set of phrases, leaving explicit variants such as 意思正确, 基本正确, 错误，影响得分 and 存在遗漏 uncolored.
changes: Recognize numbered question headings without treating ordinary numbered prose as a question boundary; keep all grammar knowledge, English examples, Chinese examples and corrections together.
Use a dedicated verdict classifier for correct, acceptable and error variants; unknown verdicts remain neutral and stale decoration is cleared.
Reparse the existing saved Markdown without rewriting learning data or calling a model.
